title: Poster Session
text:
The poster session runs 5:00 – 7:00 in CGIS Knafel, Fisher Family Commons, with a happy hour and pizza. Poster Session Awards and concluding remarks from Gal, Sam, and Jack are announced at 7:00.

title: About
text: The Democracy and Political Violence Conference & Collaborative convenes researchers working on political violence and (anti-)democratic attitudes. Our first conference will be held at Harvard University in Cambridge, MA before APSA 2026.

title: About
text:
Organizers
The conference is organized by Sam Fuller, Gal Bitton, and Jack T. Rametta.

title: About
text:
Sponsors
The conference is supported by Center for American Political Studies (CAPS) and the Weatherhead Center at Harvard University.

title: Democracy and Political ViolenceConference & Collaborative
text:
About the conference
The Democracy and Political Violence Collaborative brings together researchers studying political violence and (anti-)democratic attitudes across comparative and national contexts. The day features three main panels, a poster session, and structured opportunities to connect researchers.
Organized by Sam Fuller, Gal Bitton, and Jack T. Rametta.
